planPhases.title: Extract filter helper: move search/category/inStock filtering into a dedicated named function with idiomatic boolean checks
planPhases.notes: Extracted applyFilters(products, query) helper. Replaced !== undefined checks with idiomatic truthiness for search/category; kept inStock's === undefined guard (needed to distinguish false from absent). All 19 tests pass. Build failure on DEFAULT_LIMIT is pre-existing (noUnusedLocals) and is phase-3 work.
